channel.title: Digipod Studio Journal
channel.description: Planning ideas for quinceañeras, weddings and birthdays.

item.title: Sweet 16 or quinceañera? Differences and how to blend them
item.description: Sweet 16 vs quinceañera: the age, the traditions and the feel of each party, plus easy ways to blend both into one celebration your family loves.

item.title: Quinceañera traditions explained: last doll, shoes and more
item.description: What each quinceañera tradition means, from the thanksgiving mass and the crown to the last doll, the shoe ceremony, the waltz and the toast.

item.title: How to collect quinceañera RSVPs online with a website
item.description: Set up online RSVPs for a quinceañera with a website invitation: what to ask, when to set the deadline, how to share the link and how to track every reply.

item.title: Quinceañera slideshow songs: how to choose and how long
item.description: How long a quinceañera slideshow should be, how many songs and photos you need, song ideas for each part of her story, and how to add music in Canva.

item.title: Quinceañera invitation wording: examples in English and Spanish
item.description: What to write on a quinceañera invitation, in what order, with formal, modern and bilingual examples you can copy and adapt.

item.title: Cronograma para tu quinceañera: cuándo enviar el save the date, las invitaciones y preparar el video
item.description: Un cronograma mes a mes para organizar los XV años, desde el primer save the date hasta el slideshow de la fiesta.

item.title: Digital or printed quinceañera invitations? How to choose, and how to do both
item.description: Video invitations, invitation websites and printed cards compared, with a simple way to combine them so every guest gets the right one.

item.title: How to edit a quinceañera slideshow template in Canva, step by step
item.description: Add your photos and video clips, change the names and music, and download an MP4 for the venue screen, with tips to avoid the usual mistakes.

item.title: First birthday slideshow ideas: what to include, month by month
item.description: How to plan a first birthday slideshow, with photo ideas for each of the twelve months and tips for music, length and the party screen.

item.title: Quinceañera color themes: 12 palettes and how to carry them through every invitation
item.description: Twelve quinceañera color palettes, from blush and gold to emerald and champagne, with ideas for the dress, decor and matching invitations.

item.title: Quinceañera planning timeline: when to send the save the date, invitations and slideshow
item.description: A month-by-month quinceañera timeline, from the first save the date to the slideshow on the night, with the dates worked out for you.
